menu.title: Quick actions
menu.emptyHint: A quick action replays a saved routine with one click: restock your bases, tidy up your lists, whatever you set it to do.

run.title: {{name}}
run.planning: Working out what this will do…
run.nothingToDo: Nothing to do: everything is already the way this action wants it.
run.deletesHint: Deleting a wishlist cannot be undone.

warnings.add-supply.noBaseInScope: An "Add supply" step sits outside a "For each base" step, so it has no base to read rates from.
warnings.add-supply.nonPositiveDays: An "Add supply" step has no day count set.
warnings.add-supply.noStreamsSelected: An "Add supply" step has no materials selected.
warnings.add-supply.cappedByCargo: An "Add supply" step wanted {{tons}} t but only {{fitted}} t of the cargo limit was left, so it was trimmed to fit.
warnings.for-each-base.unknownPlanet: A selected base could not be found and was skipped.
warnings.write.unknownBase: A base could not be matched to a wishlist and was skipped.
warnings.write.nothingToWrite: A write step had nothing on the list to send.
warnings.write.wishlistMissing: The chosen wishlist no longer exists, so a new one will be created.
warnings.block.unknownKind: This action uses a step this version does not know, and it was skipped.
warnings.tree.tooDeep: This action is nested too deeply to run.
warnings.tree.tooManyBlocks: This action has too many steps to run.
warnings.unknown: Something in this action could not be applied.
warnings.remove.nothingSelected: A remove step is empty, so it does nothing.
warnings.remove.noMatches: A remove step matched nothing. It may sit above the step that adds the material rather than below it.
warnings.material.noneChosen: A material step has no material picked.
warnings.material.noBaseInScope: A material step is not inside a base loop, so it has no base to order for.
warnings.material.needsSubject: "All", percentages and "keep" only mean something inside a remove step. Use a fixed amount here.
warnings.repeat.empty: A repeat step has no materials in its batch, so it does nothing.
warnings.repeat.emptyBatch: A repeat step's batch came out empty. Its materials may need a fixed amount.
warnings.repeat.noBaseInScope: A repeat step is not inside a base loop, so it has no base to order for.
warnings.repeat.noneNeeded: A repeat step ordered nothing: the base is already stocked for that period.
warnings.material.unknownVariable: A step refers to a variable that does not exist.
warnings.material.badFormula: A step's amount is not a formula this can work out.
warnings.repeat.badCount: A repeat step's count is not a formula this can work out.
warnings.repeat.unknownVariable: A repeat step refers to a variable that does not exist.
warnings.material.noWeight: A material step limited by tonnage has no weight for that material.
warnings.material.badRounding: A material step has a rounding multiple this cannot work out.
warnings.cargo-limit.badTons: A cargo limit has a capacity this cannot work out.
warnings.cargo-limit.unknownVariable: A cargo limit refers to a variable that does not exist.
warnings.cargo-limit.overweight: An order comes to {{tons}} t against a {{capacityTons}} t cargo limit, and nothing in it can be trimmed to fit.
warnings.cargo-limit.trimmed: An order came to {{tons}} t, so the supply steps in it were cut to fit the {{capacityTons}} t cargo limit.
warnings.fill-remaining.empty: A fill step has no materials in it, so there is nothing to scale.
warnings.fill-remaining.noCapacity: A fill step is not inside a cargo limit, so it has no room to fill. Its steps ran unscaled.
warnings.fill-remaining.noRoom: A fill step had no cargo left to fill: the steps outside it already use the whole limit.
warnings.repeat.noCapacity: A repeat step is set to fill the cargo, but is not inside a cargo limit.
warnings.repeat.weightlessBatch: A repeat step set to fill the cargo has a batch with no weight, so nothing bounds it.
warnings.repeat.cappedByCargo: A repeat step wanted {{wanted}} batches but only {{fitted}} fit the cargo limit.
warnings.fill-remaining.nothingToScale: A fill step has nothing to scale: no steps inside it and nothing selected to flex.
warnings.fill-remaining.noMatches: A fill step found nothing to scale on the list.
warnings.for-each-base.noneMatched: No base matched the conditions on a base loop, so it did nothing.
warnings.for-each-base.badCondition: A base loop has a condition threshold this cannot work out.
warnings.for-each-base.unknownVariable: A base loop condition refers to a variable that does not exist.

errors.missingApiKey: Add your API key in Settings to use quick actions.
errors.notFound: That quick action no longer exists.

forEachBase.title: For each base
forEachBase.description: Run the steps inside once per base.
forEachBase.label: For each of
forEachBase.allBasesHint: Follows your company: bases you build later are included too.

condition.addHint: Only run for bases that are low

addSupply.title: Add supply
addSupply.description: Add a number of days of the base's demand.
addSupply.streamsHint: Amounts are net of what the base produces itself.

stock.label: Warehouse stock
stock.deductHint: Order only what the warehouse is short of.
stock.ignoreHint: Order the full amount, whatever the warehouse holds.

amount.label: Amount
amount.allHint: However much of it the list already holds.
amount.fixedHint: This many units, whatever the list holds.
amount.percentHint: This share of what the list holds.
amount.keepHint: Cuts down to this much. Does nothing if the list is already under it.
amount.top-upHint: Orders the shortfall only, counting the warehouse and the list so far.
amount.up-to-tonsHint: As many units as fit in that much cargo.

rounding.label: Rounding
rounding.purchaseHint: Buys whole batches. 620 needed at 500 becomes 1,000.
rounding.endingHint: The warehouse lands on a multiple once it arrives. 620 needed with 200 in stock becomes 800.

remove.title: Remove
remove.description: Take the steps inside back off the list built above.
remove.label: Remove

repeat.title: Repeat batch
repeat.description: Order whole multiples of a fixed combination of materials.
repeat.label: Repeat

count.label: How many batches
count.coverHint: Rounds up to whole batches, sized by whichever material in the batch runs out first.
count.fixedHint: This many batches, whatever the base needs.

stock.label: Warehouse stock
stock.deductHint: Fewer batches when the base is already part-stocked.
stock.ignoreHint: Sizes the order from demand alone.

count.fitHint: Whole batches into whatever the cargo limit has left.

cargoLimit.title: Cargo limit
cargoLimit.description: Declares how much cargo the steps inside are ordering into.
cargoLimit.label: Cargo limit

fillRemaining.title: Fill remaining
fillRemaining.description: Scales part of the order into whatever cargo is left.
fillRemaining.label: Fill remaining
fillRemaining.tagsHint: Nothing selected scales only the steps inside this block.

write.title: Write
write.description: Sends the list built so far to a wishlist, then starts a fresh one.
write.label: Write the list so far to

editor.title: Quick actions
editor.scopeToStep: Show only this step in the result

destination.currentBaseHint: One wishlist per base, matched by planet.
destination.listHint: Everything goes into a single list.

applyModeHint.overwrite: Replace the wishlist with exactly this.
applyModeHint.add: Add these amounts on top of what is already listed.
applyModeHint.merge: Top each material up to this amount, never down.

templateHints.daily-resupply: For every base, order consumables and inputs for a day and a half.
templateHints.blank: Start from nothing and add steps yourself.
templateHints.clean-empty-wishlists: Delete every wishlist that has nothing left on it.

wishlistProgram.title: Wishlist program
wishlistProgram.description: Work out what your bases need and write it to their wishlists.

wishlistCleanup.title: Wishlist cleanup
wishlistCleanup.description: Tidy up lists you are no longer using.
wishlistCleanup.sentence: Delete every wishlist that has nothing left on it.
wishlistCleanup.nothingToDelete: Nothing to delete: every wishlist still has something on it.
wishlistCleanup.basesHint: Bases' own lists are never touched: the game keeps one per base, so an empty one is normal and cannot be deleted.

prompt.label: Ask before running
prompt.hint: Show a popup for anything marked "ask when run", so you can change it for one run without editing the action. Turn this off to always use the saved values.
prompt.nothingToAsk: Nothing is marked "ask when run" yet. Mark a value in the Action tab first, like which bases a "For" step covers.

confirm.label: Show me the plan first
confirm.hint: Review exactly what will be written or deleted, and confirm, before anything happens.

notify.label: Notifications
notify.hint: How much this action says while it runs.

modeHints.progress: A toast that counts each step off as it lands, then settles into the result.
modeHints.result: One toast when it is done.
modeHints.silent: Nothing on success. Failures still show, so a run cannot fail unnoticed.

prompt.hint: Changing this affects only this run. The action keeps its saved selection.

formula.invalid: That is not a number this can work out.
formula.grammar: Numbers, variables and + - * / with brackets. 3X means 3 * X.
formula.noVariables: No variables defined yet. Add one above the steps.
formula.negative: This cannot be a negative number.
